steps.name: Update flake inputs
steps.script: nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs update --forward-only --all

steps.name: Commit and push changes
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

if git diff --quiet; then
  echo "No flake.lock changes."
  exit 0
fi

changed_inputs=$(ruby .github/workflows/scripts/flake-update-commit-message.rb inputs "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" flake.lock)
changed_body=$(ruby .github/workflows/scripts/flake-update-commit-message.rb body "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" flake.lock)

git add flake.lock
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

commit_file=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$commit_file"' EXIT

body_lines=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed_body" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$body_lines" -eq 1 ]; then
  single_line=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed_body" | head -n1 | sed 's/: / /')
  printf 'flake: %s\n' "$single_line" > "$commit_file"
else
  if [ -n "$changed_inputs" ]; then
    commit_message="flake: update $changed_inputs"
  else
    commit_message="flake: update inputs"
  fi

  if [ -n "$changed_body" ]; then
    {
      printf '%s\n\n' "$commit_message"
      printf '%s\n' "$changed_body"
    } > "$commit_file"
  else
    printf '%s\n' "$commit_message" > "$commit_file"
  fi
fi
git commit -F "$commit_file"
final_lock="$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$final_lock"
nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
  --old-lock "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" --new-lock "$final_lock"

steps.name: Record starting revision
steps.script:
echo "UPDATE_START_REF=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
cp flake.lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock"
echo "UPDATE_OLD_LOCK=$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Update flake input
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

old_rev="$(nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs ls --json nixpkgs | jq -er '
  map(select(.input == "nixpkgs"))
  | if length == 1 then .[0].rev | select(type == "string" and length > 0) else empty end
')"
if [ -z "$old_rev" ]; then
  echo "Unable to read nixpkgs revision from flake.lock." >&2
  exit 1
fi

nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs update --forward-only nixpkgs

if git diff --quiet -- flake.lock; then
  echo "No flake input updates to commit."
  exit 0
fi

new_rev="$(nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs ls --json nixpkgs | jq -er '
  map(select(.input == "nixpkgs"))
  | if length == 1 then .[0].rev | select(type == "string" and length > 0) else empty end
')"
if [ -z "$new_rev" ]; then
  echo "Unable to read updated nixpkgs revision from flake.lock." >&2
  exit 1
fi

commit_msg="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$commit_msg"' EXIT

printf 'flake: nixpkgs %.11s -> %.11s\n' "$old_rev" "$new_rev" > "$commit_msg"

git add -- flake.lock
git commit -F "$commit_msg"

steps.name: Check committed dependency updates
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git status --short
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Push changes
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$UPDATE_START_REF" ]; then
  echo "No dependency updates to push."
  exit 0
fi

final_lock="$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$final_lock"
nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
  --old-lock "$UPDATE_OLD_LOCK" --new-lock "$final_lock"

steps.name: Update inputs
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail


  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit --no-changelog \
                      '{nixos-stable,production,staging}' nixpkgs
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit --no-changelog nixos-unstable
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only --commit '{staging,os-staging}' vpsadminos
EOF

steps.name: Update llm-agents when Codex changes
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail

  codex_version_expr='let flake = builtins.getFlake (toString ./.); in flake.inputs.llm-agents.packages.x86_64-linux.codex.version'

  current_codex_version=$(nix eval --accept-flake-config --impure --raw \
                              --expr "$codex_version_expr")
  upstream_codex_version=$(nix eval --accept-flake-config --raw \
                               github:numtide/llm-agents.nix#packages.x86_64-linux.codex.version)

  if [ "$current_codex_version" = "$upstream_codex_version" ]; then
    echo "Codex is already up to date at $current_codex_version, skipping llm-agents"
    exit 0
  fi

  echo "Updating llm-agents for Codex $current_codex_version -> $upstream_codex_version"
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" --accept-flake-config -c confctl inputs channel update --forward-only \
      --commit --no-changelog llm-agents

  updated_codex_version=$(nix eval --accept-flake-config --impure --raw \
                              --expr "$codex_version_expr")

  if [ "$updated_codex_version" != "$upstream_codex_version" ]; then
    echo "Updated llm-agents contains Codex $updated_codex_version, expected $upstream_codex_version" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
EOF

steps.name: Check and push updates
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail

nix develop -c bash <<'EOF'
  set -euo pipefail
  git show HEAD:flake.lock > "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
  nix shell "$CONFCTL_FLAKE" -c confctl inputs check-update \
    --old-lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-baseline.lock" \
    --new-lock "$RUNNER_TEMP/flake-update-final.lock"
EOF
